title: Connections
sub: Banks, cards and wallets that sync by themselves.
help: Choose the banks and cards you use. Only the ones you add are shown and synced.
twoLogins: Two logins at one company (say, two Wise accounts)? Add it again and give each a nickname.
note1: Logins are encrypted and never shown again
note3: Two failed logins in a row pause that login
missingD: Import a file from your bank or card instead.
otpNote: A bank may ask for a one-time code. If it does, use Verify login, or import a file (Settings → Import and export). Wise: create a personal token with read-only permissions.
nickReq: Nickname (required, so you can tell the logins apart)
verifyTip:
**When:** the bank texts you a code and syncs stop.
**What happens:** you sign in once here and type the code. The bank then remembers this app.
shotTip: Shows what the bank page looked like when the last login stopped.

hint.none: Enter the login below to get started.
hint.untested: Saved. Press Test connection to check the login.
hint.tested: The login works ({when}). Press Sync now to import your data.
hint.stale: Last synced {when}, over 2 days ago. Press Sync now.
hint.locked: Paused after two failed attempts in a row. Check the login, then press Unlock.

err.otp: The bank asked for a one-time code by SMS, so automatic sync is paused. Press Verify login once. Log in in the live window, enter the code, and tick “remember this device”. After that the bank knows this app, so it usually does not ask again. (Or use a CSV export: Settings → Import and export.)

job.wait: Wait for the current one to finish
job.mine: {what} {src}… {time}. Please wait, do not close this page.
job.busy: {src} is busy ({what}). Wait for it to finish before starting another.

toast.opening: Opening the bank's page… this takes a few seconds

shotD: This is what the app's bank browser saw when the last login failed. A captcha, a notice or a blank page here shows why. Every picture taken during each failed login is saved in the app's data folder, in profiles → _failed-logins (one folder per attempt, the newest 15 per bank are kept).
shotNone: No screenshot yet. Press Test connection once and let it fail, then open this again.
testLockedD: Two failures in a row. Check the login, then press Unlock.

assist.title: Verify login
assist.d1: This is the app’s own browser, shown live. Log in as you normally do, enter the code the bank sends you, and tick “remember this device” if it asks. When you reach your account, press
assist.d1c: . The bank then knows this browser, so automatic syncs should not ask for a code again.
assist.ph: Type here and press Send (for the code)
assist.hint: Click or tap the picture to focus a field, then type. "Type my…" fills a saved login without ever sending it to this page.

emptyT: No bank or card connected yet
emptyD: Press Add connection and pick your bank or card. Your transactions then come in by themselves.
